currentTriggerSummary: pr-complete: Update perps controller to latest version in extension without full feature parity
notes: The ticket asked only for the dependency bump to latest (@metamask/perps-controller ^12.0.0 -> ^15.1.0), explicitly deferring mobile feature parity to follow-up PRs. That is what shipped: the range and lockfile, the five new PerpsErrorCode -> i18n mappings the package's `satisfies Record<PerpsErrorCode, string>` constraint forces, and the Jest stub's DEFAULT_PRO_LAYOUT_PREFERENCES.chartExpanded realignment. No 15.1.0 feature (subscribeToTwapOrders, getScalePriceLadder, previewPositionModify, the Lighter venue, Chase lifecycle, or the new persisted preference fields) was adopted, matching the stated boundary. The remaining work in this run was making the bump survive the existing test suite rather than widening scope: three e2e fixtures had encoded assumptions the new controller invalidated (two state snapshots missing the new usedInUi/includeInStateLogs fields; the TP/SL spec's REST clearinghouseState disagreeing with its WebSocket mock now that 15.1.0 reads positions from one provenance-safe source and never merges the two). Verification: recipe 27/27 against the post-rebase tree, tsc exit 0, coverage VERDICT PASS, and zero outstanding review comments. Not yet confirmed: the two perps-tpsl e2e specs pass only in CI, which had not finished at completion time; that is the one claim resting on the diagnosis rather than on an observed green run.
